topic: Supermarket English: spot the mistake in "How much cost this?"

script.title: Is "How much cost this?" correct?

lines.text: I asked the cashier, "How much cost this?" Was that okay?
Close! Just add does: "How much does this cost?"
For two or more, it's "How much do these cost?"
Kit's tip: in a hurry? Just ask, how much is this?
Fix more mistakes free on lexkite.com

script.caption: Say "How much does this cost?" not "How much cost this?"
